programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Pardesi

programme.title: Blood Relation

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas yn enwi pob anifail sy'n byw yn yr anialwch, ond allwch chi enwi'r planhigyn pigog sy'n tyfu mewn lle poeth a sych fel hyn? The Tralalas explore the hot and dry desert.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd a heddiw mae'n mynd ar ei wyliau. Flying is fun, but the airport is a bit overwhelming. The animals help Pablo work out exactly what he must do.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae 'Rhen Gerwyn yn mwynhau sôn am ei anturiaethau ar y môr ac yn codi ofn ar Twt wrth sôn am fwystfilod môr. Twt doesn't believe in sea monsters but will he change his mind?

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae brêc fflôt carnifal Maer Oci wedi torri.Mae Blero a'i ffrindiau'n trio dal y fflôt. The breaks on Mayor Oci's carnival float have broken.and Blero tries to stop the runaway float.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae ein stori ni'n dechrau yn y goedwig. Tra'n mynd am dro, mae Kim a Cêt yn dod o hyd i Twrch. Our story begins in the forest. While going for a walk, Kim and Cêt find Twrch.

programme.title: New: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Mam yn mynd i barti 'baby shower' felly Dad sy'n gyfrifol am y merched heno. When Mum goes out for the evening,Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Cwstenin Cranc isho dal y sgodyn cnau mwnci fwy na mae o isho cysgu ac ma Joni'n dysgu bod pawb angen seibiant! Cwstenin Cranc wants to catch the peanut fish more than he wants to sleep!

programme.title: New: A i Y Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Llythyren heddiw yw S: 's' am sglefr fyrddio ac 's' am syrffio. Today's letter is S: 's' for 'sglefr fyrddio' (skateboarding) and 'syrffio' (surfing).

programme.title: New: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Mae hi'n boeth! Mor boeth fel bod cystadleuaeth cestyll tywod Porthoer wedi'i chanslo! It's hot! So hot that the annual Porthore sandcastle contest is cancelled!

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n amser Eisteddfod Parc Glan Gwil ac mae Sioned Siop am gystadlu. Mae angen dysgu sut i ddawnsio disgo! It's time for the Parc Glan Gwil Eisteddfod & Sioned Siop wants to compete.

programme.title: Caru Canu
programme.desc: Anturiaethau dau gi annwyl a drygionus sydd yn y gân draddodiadol hon. This traditional Welsh song follows two sweet and mischievous dogs on their adventures.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r castell tywod gododd yr Whws ddoe wedi diflannu, mae nhw'n dysgu am y môr a'r llanw. The sandcastle which the Woohoos made yesterday has disappeared, they learn how this happens.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Ceir Cwl. Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn dysgu am bopeth sy'n ymwneud â cheir, ac ewn i Unol Daleithiau America i ddysgu am Henry Ford. In this episode we'll learn about cars.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto a'i ffrindiau'n gollwng llaeth Meri Mew ac mae nhw ar frys i'w roi yn ôl. Guto and his friends accidentally spill Meri Mew's milk,they launch a daring mission to replace it.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Bro Eirwg sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Bro Eirwg join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Yr wythnos hon - y diweddara am hanes Teigr sy wedi bod ar goll a hanes Ffosil Lili ar draeth Y Barri. Story of a Tiger that has been lost and the history of Fossil Lili on Barry beach.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Cymulaubychain a Seren Fach yn cael trafferth cysgu. Mae 'na swn rhyfedd yn eu cadw'n effro. Sut mae rhoi taw arno? The friends are having trouble sleeping because of a loud noise.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harriet wedi archebu cacen arbennig ar gyfer penblwydd Nain Help Llaw yn 100 oed, ond mae popty'r pobydd wedi torri! Harriet has ordered a special cake, but the baker's oven is broken!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae pont Swopdre Fawr ar fin dymchwel - a fydd Mojo a Bo yn gallu helpu Nori ei thrwsio mewn pryd? Swoppiton Bridge is falling down, can Mojo and Bo help Nori fix a girder in time?

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Gwyneth wedi gweu siwmper i Maldwyn ond ma'r plant yn credu ei fod yn siwtio bwgan brain yn well. Gwyneth has knitted a jumper for Maldwyn but the kids think it better suits scarecrow.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop yn cael hwyl yn dringo i ben y mynydd. Mae cymaint i'w weld a'i arogli yma. Harmoni, Melodi and Bop have the best time climbing to the top of the mountain.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Heddiw mae 'na gardigan oren sy'n edrych yn ddychrynllyd iawn. Mae'r anifeiliaid i gyd ofn y bwystfil hefyd, heblaw am Lona, sydd mor ddewr a llew. There's a scary monster in Pablo's room!

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae radio'r Harbwr Feistr wedi torri ac yn anffodus, ni all gysgu heb wrando ar swn cerddoriaeth. The Harbour Master's radio has broken and he can't sleep without listening to music.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae Maer Oci am greu argraff ar Faer sy'n ymweld, mae angen help Blero i wisgo'r cadwyn llawn gemau. Mayor Oci wants to dress to impress the visiting mayor with a gemstone-encrusted chain.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Mae Kim a Cêt yn rhyddhau'r synau o'r peiriant - ond mae'r synau yn mynd yn ôl i'r anifeiliaid anghywir! Kim and Cêt release the animal sounds - but they go back to the wrong animals!

programme.title: Blwi
